mapper.select: SELECT id, member_id AS memberId, route_session_id AS runId, topic_id AS topicId, activity_id AS activityId, config_version AS configVersion, content_revision_id AS contentRevisionId, node_id AS nodeId, category, request_hash AS requestHash, status, create_time AS createTime FROM play_run_feedback WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO play_run_feedback (member_id, route_session_id, topic_id, activity_id, play_instance_id, config_version, content_revision_id, node_id, category, content, request_id, request_hash, status, create_time) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{runId}, #{topicId}, #{activityId}, #{playInstanceId}, #{configVersion}, #{contentRevisionId}, #{nodeId}, #{category}, #{content}, #{requestId}, #{requestHash}, 0, NOW(3))
